newsitem.title: UK: Watmoughs shares off as results disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Watmoughs shares off as results disappoint.

text.p: Shares in Watmoughs (Holdings) Plc fell on Tuesday after the printing company's annual results disappointed investors, dealers said.
The shares dropped 23p to 413 by 1053 GMT.

Henderson Crosthwaite analyst Louise Barton said that although poor results had been expected, the company's 1996 pre-tax profits of 22.2 million stg, down from 23.7 million in 1995, were worse than forecast.
"I'm a bit disappointed because although it was a bad year for them, I nonetheless expected they would be able to produce some sort of recovery in the second half," Barton said.
"That clearly hasn't happened, and the rate of decline in profits has been roughly the same in the second half as it was in the first."
Barton said the shares remained a good longer term bet and she would be happy to buy if the price fell to 400p.

"There will be a recovery, it's just that it will take place from a lower base," she said. "They are a company I like long term, despite the short-term disappointment." -- Andrew Marshall, London newsroom +44 171 542 4366
